es.name: Spanish
es.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Map Hindi grammatical gender (masculine/feminine) to Spanish grammatical gender (masculino/femenino). Highlight that Hindi has no neuter gender, similar to Spanish.
es.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_es' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational Spanish.

fr.name: French
fr.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Map Hindi grammatical gender (masculine/feminine) to French grammatical gender (masculin/féminin). Highlight agreements.
fr.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_fr' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational French.

de.name: German
de.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Contrast Hindi's two-gender system (masculine/feminine) with German's three-gender system (masculine/feminine/neuter). Notice that Hindi lacks neuter.
de.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_de' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational German.

ja.name: Japanese
ja.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Contrast Hindi's strict grammatical gender with Japanese, which lacks grammatical noun gender entirely. Explain that adjective and verb agreements must be learned via Hindi rules.
ja.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_ja' and translate instructional texts and explanations into natural, educational Japanese.

zh.name: Mandarin Chinese
zh.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Contrast Hindi's strict grammatical gender with Mandarin Chinese, which has no grammatical gender for inanimate nouns. Notice verb and adjective agreements in Hindi.
zh.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_zh' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational Simplified Chinese.

ko.name: Korean
ko.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Contrast Hindi's strict grammatical gender with Korean, which has no grammatical gender. Explain agreement rules clearly in Korean.
ko.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_ko' and translate instructional texts and explanations into natural, polite, educational Korean.

it.name: Italian
it.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Map Hindi grammatical gender (masculine/feminine) directly to Italian grammatical gender (maschile/femminile). Draw parallels with adjective agreement.
it.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_it' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational Italian.

pt.name: Portuguese
pt.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Map Hindi grammatical gender (masculine/feminine) directly to Portuguese grammatical gender (masculino/feminino). Highlight adjective agreements.
pt.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_pt' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational Portuguese.

ru.name: Russian
ru.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Contrast Hindi's two-gender system (masculine/feminine) with Russian's three-gender system (masculine/feminine/neuter). Emphasize verb past tense agreement in Hindi vs Russian.
ru.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_ru' and translate instructional texts and explanations into natural, educational Russian.

ar.name: Arabic
ar.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Map Hindi grammatical gender (masculine/feminine) directly to Arabic grammatical gender (مذكر/مؤनथ). Note that both languages have a strong distinction of gender in verbs and adjectives.
ar.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_ar' and translate instructional texts and explanations into high-quality, classical Arabic.

nl.name: Dutch
nl.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Map noun genders to common and neuter.
nl.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_nl' and translate.

te.name: Telugu
te.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Telugu is an Abugida language with distinct gender/agreement attributes.
te.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_te' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational Telugu.

bn.name: Bengali
bn.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Bengali is an Abugida language with no grammatical noun gender but extensive vowel/consonant classification rules.
bn.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_bn' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational Bengali.

mr.name: Marathi
mr.grammar_gender_benchmarks: Marathi uses Devanagari script, three-gender system (masculine/feminine/neuter).
mr.instructional_rules: Rename keys with suffix '_en' to '_mr' and translate instructional texts and explanations into clear, educational Marathi.
